claims: Source-fact Q&A with native evidence supplied; not human-reviewed defect gold or image-only OCR evaluation
attribution: Adafruit Industries; each source retains its original README and CC-BY-SA-3.0 license text.
split_unit: GitHub board repository; all sheets and revisions stay together. Related products may still share subcircuits.
limitations: Machine-extracted native facts, not human-verified electrical findings.

Derivative circuit-crop rendering uses original EAGLE geometry and a bounded renderer, not the vendor application. Frames/fiducials do not expand crop bounds; original notices remain in retained source files and an attribution footer is rendered. Unsupported primitives are rejected.
Evidence-assisted dialogues supply BOM/net facts in the prompt; image-only dialogues are separately located under vision/.
No claim of OCR accuracy or model performance follows from source parsing or gold-answer self-checks.
rebuild: uv run python -m schematic_model.corpus --manifest corpora/adafruit-120.json --out data/real --limit 120
